text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... Hahahahaha...! 
Good grief, to think you'd all dance right into my hands so perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That's right... The real Seer was that person you unanimously lynched yesterday.
And I, the one you all placed your faith in, am a fake Seer... the Werewolf—!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Come forth, my brethren! Reveal yourselves! Bare your fangs!
From here on out, it's a Power Play—!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Two nooses left to spare, and the Werewolf team completely survives...
Heh-heh-heh, an effortless clean sweep. GG, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Time for a little break.
Oh right, Trainer is............ not logged in.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, still working?
Even though your trainee is on a rest day...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "You free right now?" No, that makes it sound like I've got nothing to do.
"What are you up to?" ...Hmm, wouldn't that just make them go, "Why do you ask?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
..................Wait.
What... should I send...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah, they definitely look busy with work.
Hrmmm... What should I do... Knock? No, that's...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That afternoon, I was catching up on a mountain of paperwork.
Since today was Rulership's rest day, I wanted to clear it all out in one go.
choice_data_list: Alright! That's a good stopping point...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I figured I'd grab some coffee and take a short breather.
With that in mind, I stepped into the hallway, only to—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa! T-Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership was standing right outside the door.
Had she just arrived at the Trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? I was simply passing by.
Hahaha, surely you can see that. ...Well then, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That was close...!
If they realized I was just pacing around aimlessly, who knows what they'd think...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
How did I usually handle this kind of thing before?
Uhhh... Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, do I even have a reason to see them without actual business...? Yes, I do! Of course I do!
Healthy communication is essential for racing, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
But getting too casual might be a problem...
It's easy enough for me to reach out, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Just think about it. If someone like me went scurrying up to them
like a little puppy with no real reason at all...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Heheh, look who came to visiiit♪

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, where did this come from all of a sudden?
I didn't know Ruler was that kind of person..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Cringe overload...!!
No way! That's way too uncool! I'd never recover from that!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My entire "cool Domi-san" persona would be shattered to pieces!
All the hard work I put into building that image...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I must defend my dignity at all costs... A blow to my image could dampen Trainer's morale.
This calls for a tactical scheme—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Increase contact while firmly maintaining my upper hand.
The ultimate objective... a "relationship where we can meet even without business!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheheh...
Fascinating. Let's see how this plays out!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Time to regroup and formulate concrete moves.
Now then, how shall I make my approach naturally...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: GWAAAAAAAHHH?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worried about Rulership, I decided to visit her base of operations,
only to catch her completely off guard.
choice_data_list: I just wanted to check in on you. Got a minute to chat?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wha...?! 
...Ahem. No—of course, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she let me inside.
Judging by how she looked... it seemed my worries were completely unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So my earlier move inadvertently served as the opening gambit,
drawing you right to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, that should be my line.
Lady Luck was on my side this time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, next time, I shall orchestrate the entire board.
No matter the layout, the initiative belongs entirely to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She flashed a confident grin.
I didn't quite understand, but Rulership seemed full of energy as always!
